name: internet-speed-checker
description: SpeedPulse is a browser-based internet speed tester with an optional ASP.NET Core backend.

scripts.build: npm run build:app && npm run build:labs && npm run build:diagnostics
scripts.typecheck:engine: tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --strict --target ES2020 --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler --lib ES2020,DOM src/test-profiles.ts src/speedtest.ts src/history.ts
